summary: Noemi Castillo, 26, is an IT support technician on the Ridgeline RF-4 on-site help desk, where she fixes handheld scanners, badge readers and frozen laptops and knows half the night shift by their broken devices. She lives with her girlfriend Iris in a Verdant Commons one-bedroom by Flats Junction and spends weekends studying for a network certification she has quietly been circling for a year. At the start of the horizon her lead Greg is coasting toward the exit, peak season is approaching, and she is training new hire Bao on scanner repairs. She wants the lead job, or at least proof she could do it, but hates asking for things from management. When Greg leaves in October and Victor gets the acting-lead title, she ends up doing Greg's work anyway, and the mandatory-overtime surge makes the scanner fleet her personal fire. She preaches password hygiene at work while reusing one password for everything personal. Her pressing worries are the cert exam date, the lead role, and whether she should start looking outside Ridgeline.
